doc_summary: `level.chunk_ref(host, [x, z])` makes a handle for any chunk of an open level, loaded or not. `chunk.forced(host)` and `level.forced_chunks(host)` read the chunks `/forceload` keeps loaded (`/forceload query`); `chunk.set_forced(host, bool)` is `/forceload add` or `remove` of one chunk (`ServerLevel.setChunkForced`) and returns whether the set changed. Works for the level in place and for levels the server has open but parked; the chunk loads over the next ticks, not before the call returns. Forcing is persistent, world-owned `/forceload` state, not a ticket the mod owns: chunks stay forced across restarts and after the mod is unloaded or removed, until `set_forced(false)` or `/forceload remove` clears them. A stale handle returns `None` or `false`.
